messages:
Maria Chen: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: landed kernel microbatch allocator fix (PR #492). Blockers: flaky KV eviction on canary node, saw p95 regressions in nightbench. Today: run focused perf sweep, push hotfix if reproducer stable.

Owen Patel: Thanks — saw the PR, left a couple nits. Can you add a unit test for slot stealing? Also, which canary cluster did you hit?

Maria Chen: Canary cluster c-canary-7. Repro steps in the PR, but local repro is non-deterministic. I captured logs: ```[2026-03-15T03:12:01Z] eviction: dropped 3 hot entries due to slot-steal race``` Trying a build with extra instrumentation.

Jules Rivera: For bench sweep, can we include the microburst profile (seq_len 64/128) + batching window 8ms? Use `bench/run --model gpt-small --seq 64,128 --batch-window-ms 8` and tag results.

Kayla Nguyen: Heads-up — @infra-bot flagged memory pressure on c-canary-7 yesterday (oom ~1h ago). Might be related. @infra-bot can you paste the node snapshot?

infra-bot: Node snapshot for c-canary-7: mem_free 1.2GB, vm_rss 14.8GB, swap 0.0GB. Recent deploy: kernel v2.14.3. No disk pressure. Logged to incidents/1722.

Owen Patel: If memory pressure is real, run the bench with `--max-cache-entries 5000` to avoid oversubscription.

Maria Chen: Good call. Will try that. ETA for sweep: noon PT. Ping me if you want specific trace.

Jules Rivera: Quick code-review ping: I reviewed the allocator change — mostly ok, but the `slot_claim` path needs a guard when `batcher == nullptr`. Left inline.

Maria Chen: Got it, fixing now.

Kayla Nguyen: Blocker for me: need a small infra change to expose `kv.evict.threshold` via feature flag for canary. I'll open infra PR after lunch.

Owen Patel: Can someone run the microbench with the new kernel turned on vs off and post p95/p99? That will help isolate perf delta.

Maria Chen: Will post results here. If sweep passes, I'll flip the canary to v2.14.3-hotfix and coordinate rollout.

Jules Rivera: :thumbsup: 

Maria Chen: results so far (quick): v2.14.3 baseline p95=12.4ms p99=38.7ms; after allocator fix p95=11.1ms p99=35.2ms (seq64, batch window 8ms). Uploading full logs to S3: s3://redwood-ci/maria/1722/sweep-logs.tar.gz

Kayla Nguyen: Nice improvement. After infra flag lands, let's run larger sample.

Owen Patel: I can help run the larger run at 2pm PT.

Maria Chen: thanks all — will post PRs and update the canary incident once done. Ending notes: minor test flakiness still; if anyone sees weird evictions tonight, tag me.
